parameters.query:
-- One command: recorded, applied, and answered, in a single statement.
--
-- The record is written before the effect and the effect depends on the
-- record, so a command cannot take effect without being logged. command_log
-- has a UNIQUE update_id, so an update that arrives twice - which happens
-- whenever the offset fails to save after a command was applied - inserts
-- nothing the second time, and every UPDATE below is guarded on that insert
-- having happened. Replay is a no-op rather than a second approval.
--
-- 2026-09-29: /approve takes several ids at once ("/approve 7f3a 0c21 9be4"),
-- each still one draft the operator read, so twenty approvals are one message, not
-- twenty. /stats, /pipeline and /stage are the sales side: what the funnel
-- says, who is talking to us, and where each conversation stands
-- (0024_icp_segments.sql).
--
-- 0026: /stage audit records the paid Process Automation Audit, the amount a
-- /stage names is kept on its lead_events row (revenue is counted from there),
-- and /campaigns shows each campaign's funnel (0026_first_revenue.sql).
--
-- 0030: /autosend on|off|status and /stop, the operator's switch for guarded autosend
-- (decided 2026-10-08). The work is autosend_command(), called once per
-- logged update and only for the authorised chat. /autosend on is refused
-- while OUTREACH_AUTOSEND_ENABLED, the master switch in .env, is not "true".
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
cfg AS (
    SELECT (j ->> 'update_id')::bigint          AS update_id,
           j ->> 'chat_id'                      AS chat_id,
           lower(j ->> 'command')               AS command,
           NULLIF(btrim(j ->> 'argument'), '')  AS argument,
           NULLIF(btrim(j ->> 'reason'), '')    AS reason,
           ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j -> 'args', '[]'::jsonb))) AS args,
           (j ->> 'authorised')::boolean        AS authorised,
           (j ->> 'paused')::boolean            AS paused,
           COALESCE((j ->> 'autosend_env')::boolean, false) AS autosend_env,
           j ->> 'languages'                    AS languages,
           j ->> 'timezone'                     AS timezone
    FROM p
),
res AS (
    SELECT a.ord, a.arg, r.outreach_id, r.matches
    FROM cfg
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(
        CASE WHEN cfg.command = 'approve' AND cardinality(cfg.args) > 0 THEN cfg.args
             ELSE ARRAY[COALESCE(cfg.argument, '')] END
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(arg, ord)
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL resolve_outreach_prefix(a.arg) r ON true
),
-- /stage <id> <stage> [value in EUR] [note]. The id is a lead's or any of its
-- drafts' first characters, as /pipeline and the approval messages show them.
stage_cfg AS (
    SELECT CASE lower(COALESCE(cfg.args[2], ''))
               WHEN 'interested' THEN 'opportunity'
               WHEN 'opportunity' THEN 'opportunity'
               WHEN 'meeting'    THEN 'meeting'
               WHEN 'call'       THEN 'meeting'
               WHEN 'audit'      THEN 'audit'
               WHEN 'proposal'   THEN 'proposal'
               WHEN 'won'        THEN 'closed_won'
               WHEN 'lost'       THEN 'closed_lost'
               WHEN 'nurture'    THEN 'nurture'
           END AS stage,
           CASE WHEN cfg.args[3] ~ '^[0-9]{1,7}$' THEN cfg.args[3]::int END AS value_eur,
           NULLIF(array_to_string(cfg.args[CASE WHEN cfg.args[3] ~ '^[0-9]{1,7}$' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END:], ' '), '') AS note
    FROM cfg
),
stage_lead AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT l.id) = 1 THEN (array_agg(l.id))[1] END AS lead_id,
           count(DISTINCT l.id)::int AS matches
    FROM cfg, leads l
    WHERE cfg.command = 'stage'
      AND length(COALESCE(cfg.argument, '')) >= 4
      AND (l.id::text LIKE lower(cfg.argument) || '%'
           OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach o
                      WHERE o.lead_id = l.id AND o.id::text LIKE lower(cfg.argument) || '%'))
),
verdict AS (
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN NOT cfg.authorised THEN 'unauthorised'
        WHEN cfg.command NOT IN ('approve','reject','leads','status','help','stats','pipeline','stage','campaigns',
                                 'autosend','stop') THEN 'unknown'
        WHEN cfg.command = 'stop' THEN 'applied'
        WHEN cfg.command = 'autosend' THEN CASE
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(cfg.argument, 'status')) NOT IN ('on', 'off', 'status', 'stop') THEN 'bad_autosend'
            -- The master switch is .env, not Telegram: a phone cannot turn it on.
            WHEN lower(cfg.argument) = 'on' AND NOT cfg.autosend_env THEN 'refused'
            ELSE 'applied' END
        WHEN cfg.command IN ('leads','status','help','stats','pipeline','campaigns') THEN 'applied'
        WHEN cfg.command = 'stage' THEN CASE
            WHEN (SELECT matches FROM stage_lead) = 0 THEN 'not_found'
            WHEN (SELECT matches FROM stage_lead) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous'
            WHEN (SELECT stage FROM stage_cfg) IS NULL THEN 'bad_stage'
            ELSE 'applied' END
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM res WHERE matches = 1) THEN 'applied'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM res WHERE matches > 1) THEN 'ambiguous'
        ELSE 'not_found'
    END AS outcome
    FROM cfg
),
logged AS (
    INSERT INTO command_log (update_id, chat_id, command, argument, outcome, detail)
    SELECT cfg.update_id, cfg.chat_id, cfg.command,
           CASE WHEN cardinality(cfg.args) > 0 THEN array_to_string(cfg.args, ' ') ELSE cfg.argument END,
           -- command_log keeps the outcomes 0014 defined; a stage word it does
           -- not know is logged as not_found.
           CASE verdict.outcome WHEN 'bad_stage' THEN 'not_found' WHEN 'bad_autosend' THEN 'not_found'
                                ELSE verdict.outcome END,
           cfg.reason
    FROM cfg, verdict
    ON CONFLICT (update_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING update_id
),
approved AS (
    UPDATE outreach o
    SET status           = 'approved',
        approved_by      = 'telegram:' || (SELECT chat_id FROM cfg),
        approved_at      = now(),
        rejection_reason = NULL
    WHERE o.id IN (SELECT outreach_id FROM res WHERE matches = 1)
      AND o.status = 'pending_approval'
      AND (SELECT command FROM cfg) = 'approve'
      AND (SELECT authorised FROM cfg)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logged)
    RETURNING o.id, o.lead_id
),
rejected AS (
    UPDATE outreach o
    SET status           = 'rejected',
        rejection_reason = COALESCE((SELECT reason FROM cfg), 'rejected from Telegram')
    WHERE o.id = (SELECT outreach_id FROM res WHERE matches = 1 ORDER BY ord LIMIT 1)
      AND o.status = 'pending_approval'
      AND (SELECT command FROM cfg) = 'reject'
      AND (SELECT authorised FROM cfg)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logged)
    RETURNING o.id, o.lead_id
),
lead_moved AS (
    UPDATE leads l
    SET status = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approved WHERE lead_id = l.id)
                      THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END
    WHERE l.id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM approved UNION ALL SELECT lead_id FROM rejected)
    RETURNING l.id
),
staged AS (
    UPDATE leads l
    SET status         = (SELECT stage FROM stage_cfg),
        deal_value_eur = COALESCE((SELECT value_eur FROM stage_cfg), l.deal_value_eur)
    WHERE l.id = (SELECT lead_id FROM stage_lead)
      AND (SELECT outcome FROM verdict) = 'applied'
      AND (SELECT command FROM cfg) = 'stage'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logged)
    RETURNING l.id, l.status, l.deal_value_eur, l.company_id
),
stage_event AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id, stage, note, actor, value_eur)
    SELECT s.id, s.status, (SELECT note FROM stage_cfg), 'telegram:' || (SELECT chat_id FROM cfg),
           (SELECT value_eur FROM stage_cfg)
    FROM staged s
    RETURNING id
),
-- /autosend and /stop (0030_autosend.sql). Runs once: only when this update
-- was logged now, so a replayed /autosend on does not sweep the queue twice.
autosend AS (
    SELECT autosend_command(
               CASE WHEN cfg.command = 'stop' THEN 'off' ELSE lower(COALESCE(cfg.argument, 'status')) END,
               'telegram:' || cfg.chat_id, cfg.autosend_env, cfg.languages, cfg.timezone, cfg.paused) AS reply
    FROM cfg, verdict
    WHERE cfg.command IN ('autosend', 'stop')
      AND cfg.authorised
      AND verdict.outcome IN ('applied', 'refused')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logged)
),
-- The subject of whichever rows were just touched, for the confirmation.
touched AS (
    -- A role contact (0022) has no name; show its address instead of nothing.
    SELECT string_agg(c.name || ' — ' || COALESCE(pe.full_name, pe.email || ' (general address)'),
                      E'\n' ORDER BY c.name) AS text,
           count(*)::int AS n
    FROM (SELECT lead_id FROM approved UNION ALL SELECT lead_id FROM rejected
          UNION ALL SELECT id FROM staged) t
    JOIN leads l     ON l.id = t.lead_id
    JOIN companies c ON c.id = l.company_id
    JOIN people pe   ON pe.id = l.person_id
),
-- Ids typed with /approve that did not resolve to exactly one waiting draft.
misses AS (
    SELECT string_agg(format('"%s" %s', arg,
                             CASE WHEN matches > 1 THEN 'matches more than one' ELSE 'matches nothing waiting' END),
                      E'\n' ORDER BY ord) AS text
    FROM res WHERE COALESCE(matches, 0) <> 1
),
queue AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        string_agg(format('%s  [%s]  %s — %s',
                          left(outreach_id::text, 4),
                          COALESCE(score::text, '?'),
                          company_name,
                          full_name),
                   E'\n' ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST),
        'Nothing is waiting for approval.') AS text
    FROM v_approval_queue
),
stats AS (
    SELECT format(
        'Awaiting approval: %s%sSent today: %s%sReplies: %s%sOpen opportunities: %s%sAgent failures: %s%s%sOutbound: %s',
        awaiting_approval, E'\n', messages_sent, E'\n', replies_received, E'\n',
        open_opportunities, E'\n', agent_failures, E'\n', E'\n',
        CASE WHEN (SELECT paused FROM cfg) THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE 'running' END) AS text
    FROM v_daily_stats
),
kpis AS (
    SELECT concat_ws(E'\n',
        'SALES CONVERSATIONS: ' || k.sales_conversations,
        'Calls ' || k.meetings || ' · audits ' || k.audits || ' · proposals ' || k.proposals ||
            ' · won ' || k.clients || ' · lost ' || k.lost,
        'REVENUE €' || k.revenue_eur || ' · open pipeline €' || k.pipeline_eur,
        '',
        'Last 24h: discovered ' || k.companies_24h || ' · drafted ' || k.drafted_24h ||
            ' · approved ' || k.approved_24h || ' · sent ' || k.sent_24h || ' · replies ' || k.replies_24h,
        '',
        'Contacted ' || k.leads_contacted || ' leads, ' || k.emails_sent || ' emails (' || k.emails_sent_7d || ' in 7 days)',
        'Replied ' || k.replied || ' (' || COALESCE(k.reply_rate_pct::text, '-') || '%) · bounced ' || k.bounced ||
            ' (' || COALESCE(k.bounce_rate_pct::text, '-') || '%) · unsubscribed ' || k.unsubscribed,
        'Awaiting approval ' || k.awaiting_approval || ' · qualified ' || k.qualified || ' · companies ' || k.companies ||
            ' (+' || k.companies_7d || ' in 7 days)',
        '',
        'By segment (companies / qualified / contacted / replied / conversations):',
        (SELECT string_agg(format('%s%s: %s / %s / %s / %s / %s', segment, CASE WHEN active THEN '' ELSE ' (off)' END,
                                  companies, qualified, contacted, replied, conversations), E'\n')
         FROM v_segment_results)) AS text
    FROM v_sales_kpis k
),
campaign_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(concat_ws(E'\n',
               r.campaign || CASE WHEN r.active IS FALSE THEN ' (ended)' ELSE '' END ||
                   COALESCE(' · ' || r.segment || ' · ' || r.message_variant, ''),
               '  contacted ' || r.contacted || ' · replied ' || r.replied ||
                   ' (' || COALESCE(r.reply_rate_pct::text, '-') || '%) · conversations ' || r.conversations,
               '  calls ' || r.calls || ' · audits ' || r.audits || ' · proposals ' || r.proposals ||
                   ' · won ' || r.won || ' · €' || r.revenue_eur),
           E'\n\n'), 'No campaigns yet.') AS text
    FROM v_campaign_results r
),
pipeline AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(format('%s  %s  %s%s%s', left(o.lead_id::text, 4), o.status, c.name,
                                      CASE WHEN o.deal_value_eur IS NOT NULL THEN ' · €' || o.deal_value_eur ELSE '' END,
                                      COALESCE(' · last: ' || (
                                          SELECT m.classification FROM conversations cv JOIN messages m ON m.conversation_id = cv.id
                                          WHERE cv.lead_id = o.lead_id AND m.direction = 'inbound'
                                          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1), '')),
                               E'\n' ORDER BY o.status, c.name),
                    'No conversations yet.') AS text
    FROM v_lead_outcomes o
    JOIN companies c ON c.id = o.company_id
    WHERE o.replied OR o.conversation
       OR o.status IN ('replied', 'opportunity', 'meeting', 'audit', 'proposal', 'closed_won')
)
SELECT (SELECT outcome FROM verdict)                    AS outcome,
       (SELECT command FROM cfg)                        AS command,
       (SELECT update_id FROM cfg)                      AS update_id,
       -- NULL means send nothing. An unauthorised chat gets no answer at all:
       -- a reply confirms the bot is live and tells the sender they found
       -- something real.
       CASE (SELECT outcome FROM verdict)
           WHEN 'unauthorised' THEN NULL
           WHEN 'unknown' THEN
               'Unknown command. /help lists them.'
           WHEN 'bad_stage' THEN
               'Which stage? /stage <id> interested|meeting|audit|proposal|won|lost|nurture [value €] [note]'
           WHEN 'bad_autosend' THEN
               '/autosend on | /autosend off | /autosend (stanje) | /stop'
           WHEN 'refused' THEN
               COALESCE((SELECT reply FROM autosend), 'Već obrađeno.')
           WHEN 'not_found' THEN
               CASE WHEN (SELECT argument FROM cfg) IS NULL
                    THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT command FROM cfg) = 'stage'
                              THEN 'Which lead? /pipeline lists them.'
                              ELSE 'Which draft? Say /approve <id> or /reject <id>. /leads lists them.' END
                    ELSE format('Nothing matches "%s".', (SELECT argument FROM cfg))
               END
           WHEN 'ambiguous' THEN
               format('"%s" matches more than one. Type more characters.',
                      (SELECT argument FROM cfg))
           ELSE CASE (SELECT command FROM cfg)
               WHEN 'help'   THEN concat_ws(E'\n',
                   '/leads - drafts waiting for you, with their ids',
                   '/approve <id> [<id> ...] - send those drafts in the next window',
                   '/reject <id> [reason] - drop it; the reason is kept',
                   '/stats - the sales funnel, revenue, last 24h, results per segment',
                   '/campaigns - each campaign from contacted to revenue',
                   '/pipeline - everyone who replied, and where it stands',
                   '/stage <id> interested|meeting|audit|proposal|won|lost [value €] [note]',
                   '  audit 1200 = the paid audit; won <€> = what the build is invoiced',
                   '/status - today in numbers',
                   '/autosend on|off - first messages that pass every check go out without /approve; /autosend shows the state',
                   '/stop - autosend off now; drafts it approved and not yet sent come back to you',
                   '',
                   'The id is the first characters shown by /leads or /pipeline; four is enough.')
               WHEN 'leads'    THEN (SELECT text FROM queue)
               WHEN 'status'   THEN (SELECT text FROM stats)
               WHEN 'stats'    THEN (SELECT text FROM kpis)
               WHEN 'pipeline' THEN (SELECT text FROM pipeline)
               WHEN 'campaigns' THEN (SELECT text FROM campaign_lines)
               WHEN 'autosend' THEN COALESCE((SELECT reply FROM autosend), 'Već obrađeno.')
               WHEN 'stop'     THEN COALESCE((SELECT reply FROM autosend), 'Već obrađeno.')
               WHEN 'stage' THEN
                   COALESCE((SELECT format('%s: %s%s', (SELECT stage FROM stage_cfg), text,
                                           COALESCE(' · €' || (SELECT value_eur FROM stage_cfg), '')) FROM touched WHERE n > 0),
                            'Nothing changed.')
               WHEN 'approve' THEN
                   concat_ws(E'\n',
                       COALESCE((SELECT format('Approved %s:%s%s%sWF-06 sends in the next window.',
                                               n, E'\n', text, E'\n') FROM touched WHERE n > 0),
                                'Nothing changed: no draft named is still awaiting approval.'),
                       (SELECT 'Not approved:' || E'\n' || text FROM misses WHERE text IS NOT NULL))
               WHEN 'reject' THEN
                   COALESCE((SELECT format('Rejected: %s.', text) FROM touched WHERE n > 0),
                            'Nothing changed: that draft is no longer awaiting approval.')
           END
       END AS reply;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ update_id: $json.update_id, chat_id: $json.chat_id, command: $json.command, argument: $json.argument, reason: $json.reason, args: $json.args, authorised: $json.authorised, paused: String($env.OUTREACH_PAUSED ?? 'true').toLowerCase() !== 'false', autosend_env: String($env.OUTREACH_AUTOSEND_ENABLED ?? 'false').trim() === 'true', languages: String($env.OUTREACH_LANGUAGES ?? ''), timezone: $env.GENERIC_TIMEZONE || 'UTC' } ) }}

nodes.name: Apply Command
nodes.notes: Records and applies in one statement. Replay is a no-op.

nodes.name: Reply Needed?
nodes.notes: An unauthorised chat is answered with silence.

nodes.name: Send Reply
nodes.notes: Uses the credential, so no token in this node. parse_mode empty: command output is data, not markup.

parameters.query:
-- Acknowledge everything up to and including this update.
--
-- GREATEST rather than a plain assignment: this node runs once per command in
-- the batch and n8n does not promise an order, so a late-arriving smaller
-- number must not walk the offset backwards and replay the batch forever.
INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value)
VALUES ('telegram_update_offset', to_jsonb(($1::jsonb ->> 'update_id')::bigint))
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
SET value = to_jsonb(GREATEST(
        (app_settings.value)::text::bigint,
        ($1::jsonb ->> 'update_id')::bigint))
RETURNING key, value;

nodes.name: Save Offset
nodes.notes: After the effect, not before. command_log is what makes the replay safe.

assignments.name: reason
assignments.value: TELEGRAM_ENABLED, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is not set
